ORDINANCE 88-2 Cancels ORDINACE 83-1 Title: Control of weeds, grass, shrubs, or foliage within the City of Glenview Manor. Be it ordained as follows: City Ordinance 83-1 is hereby amended to provide as follows: SECTION 1 It is unlawful to permit weeds, grass, shrubs, vines or other foliage to grow on property within the City of Glenview Manor to such a height and/or thickness that it is a breeding ground for insects and rodents or otherwise jeopardizes the health of other residents. It is also unlawful not to remove debris and litter, after a reasonable time, caused by a disaster such as a tornado or fire. ORDINANCE 2002-7 Title: Sign Restrictions Be it ordained by the City of Glenview Manor as follows: SECTION 1 Placement of any commercial signs on City islands or entrances is prohibited. Signs in this prohibition include but are not limited to real estate companies, garage sales, and political campaigns. Any of the above mentioned signs may be placed on personal property, but to maintain the beauty of the City, they must be removed within 48 hours of the completion of elections, construction, sale of real estate, etc. SECTION 2 Any signs placed on City islands or entrances will be removed by the Board of Commissioners and disposed of. City residents will be responsible for the timely removal of signs on their property. SECTION 3 This ordinance shall become effective with its approval and passage by the Board of Commissioners.

ORDINANCE 2018-2 Title: Fence Restrictions SECTION 1: Installation of any residential fence must be approved by the City of Glenview Manor City Council. SECTION 2: Fences must be located behind the front wall of the residence with a maximum height of Six Feet. SECTION 3: Approved Materials for new fences – Iron, Wood, Brick, Stone or Metal. SECTION 4: Chain Link fences are prohibited. SECTION 4: This ordinance shall become effective upon its approval and passage by the Board of Commissioners. First reading on: 12-5-2017 Second reading on: 2-22-2018 Approved February 22 nd , 2018

ORDINANCE 2018-3 Title: Commercial Truck, Commercial Equipment and Trailers Ordinance SECTION 1: Any truck larger than a commercial van is prohibited from parking fulltime at any residence. SECTION 2: Any vehicle designed to carry business equipment such as having racks, storage bins or trailers is prohibited. SECTION 3: Trucks with dual rear wheels including Box Trucks are prohibited. SECTION 4: Commercial Vans, Trucks with a business logo and Trailers must be parked in the resident’s closed garage and may not be parked on the street, yard or in the driveway. SECTION 5: Commercial Lawn Mowing Equipment, Landscaping Equipment and Trailers must be stored in the resident’s closed garage and may not be parked on the street, yard or in the driveway. ORDINANCE 2002-6 Title: On-street parking prohibitions Be it ordained by the City of Glenview Manor as follows. SECTION 1 No automobile, which is inoperable, shall be habitually or repeatedly parked on any street within the City of Glenview Manor. No trailers, boats, trucks or any other vehicle, whether licensed or not, shall be parked on any street for a period in excess of 24 hours in any one calendar year. SECTION 2 Vehicles owned and operated by construction and/or service companies (i.e. plumbing, maintenance, remodelers, etc.) shall be exempt from the prohibition in SECTION 1 as long as they are working under the direct control of a resident of the City. SECTION 3 If an owner has been notified to remove a vehicle found to be in violation of SECTION 1, and 24 hours has passed, The Board of Commissioners reserved the right to have the vehicle removed at the owners expense. ORDINANCE 2004-1 Title: Construction of New Garages Be it ordained by the City of Glenview Manor as follows: SECTION 1 The exterior of any new garage constructed in the City of Glenview Manor shall be constructed using the same type of material as is used in the majority of the existing single family residence on the lot for the new construction. The door of any new garage shall not face in the same direction as the front door of any single family residence located on said lot, provided, however, that exceptions as to the placement of a new garage may be granted by the City of Glenview Manor based on the topography and shape of the particular lot in questions. This ordinance shall not apply to the replacement of existing garages on the same location and with the same building materials as of the effective date of this ordinance. ORDINANCE 90-16 Amends ORDINANCE 81-4 Title: Vending and Peddling – Restrictions and Registration Be it ordained by the City of Glenview Manor as follows: SECTION 1 It shall be unlawful for any person, firm or corporation to peddle, sell or offer for sale, either on foot door-to-door or by means of a machine or vehicle, any merchandise or service. SECTION 2 Any person violating the provisions of this Ordinance shall be fined no less than $25.00 nor more than $100.00 for each offense. Each sale in violation shall be a separate offense. SECTION 3 This ordinance shall become effective upon its passage and final approval, publishing according to law.
